name: Faena New York
positioning: Faena's art-filled hotel in the East Tower of One High Line in West Chelsea, with a South American-inspired spa across its entire underground level
best_for: Travelers who want a design-forward base beside the High Line and the Chelsea gallery district
Spa-goers drawn to thermal rituals such as hammam, sauna and steam

facts.text: Faena New York is in West Chelsea, Manhattan.
The hotel is steps from the High Line.
The hotel is in the Chelsea Art Gallery District.
Faena New York occupies the East Tower of One High Line, a building by Bjarke Ingels Group with a twisting geometric design.
The rooms and suites are designed by Alan Faena with the Faena Design Team and Peter Mikic Studios.
Rooms feature animal-print motifs, sculptural lighting and marble bathtubs.
Tierra Santa Healing House is rooted in ancient South American healing traditions.
Hotel guests get complimentary access to the Thermal Sanctuary by reservation.
La Boca by Francis Mallmann celebrates Argentine cuisine.
The Living Room offers nightly live music and cocktails.

highlights.text: Tierra Santa Healing House spa occupies the entire underground level of the hotel.
The spa's Thermal Sanctuary includes a hammam, sauna, infrared sauna, steam room and restorative pools.
Rooms and suites offer views of the Empire State Building and High Line Park.
The lobby has a spiral staircase beside a large-scale mural by Argentine artist Diego Gravinese.
The concierge works with local artists and curators on private gallery or museum tours, studio visits and neighborhood walks.

considerations.text: The hotel welcomes dogs up to 25 lbs; the pet policy is limited to dogs.
Photography, videography and audio recording are not permitted in La Boca, The Living Room and public spaces.
WhataHotel notes the bold artistic design may not appeal to traditional tastes.
